children.text: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, avocado toast, and pancakes. They highlight the beautiful presentation, high-quality ingredients, and peaceful atmosphere. They also like the friendly service.

children.description: Overflow menu of review 1 for HOUSE OF COFFEE by Harshil Sojitra

I recently visited House of Coffee in Katargam, Surat, and had an exceptional experience. I ordered the Alfredo pasta and an espresso, both of which were delicious and prepared to perfection. The food quality was outstanding—the pasta was rich and flavorful, and the espresso had a perfectly balanced taste.
The café’s ambiance is truly unique. With its open-roof setting and lush green surroundings, it offers refreshing and relaxing vibes. It’s an ideal spot for anyone looking to unwind, work, or simply enjoy a good cup of coffee.
I highly recommend visiting House of Coffee to enjoy their excellent food, great coffee, and inviting atmosphere.
Food: 5 | Service: 5 | Atmosphere: 5
Noise level: Quiet, easy to talk
Wait time: No wait
